cs.t: I recently got a pair of MetroFit 220 by LE which can be found for around 80$. ( http://www.ultimateears.com/_ultimateears/store/products/met... ) Which I like alot. They are buds, put they come with 3 plastic ear pieces of different sizes so you should be able to make them fit. I got these over an active noise canceling one since all the noise canceling ones I have used (and it could just be the ones I used) seem to let out alot of noise when noise canceling.
